Who is Legs Devil?

The の|Ashi no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of legs.

The Legs Devil's full appearance is unknown.

The Legs Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At an unknown point in time, the Death Devil was able to subdue the Legs Devil and turn it into one of her pawns.
